sideEffectsDemo.note: esbuild eliminated the bare side-effect import once "sideEffects": false was declared; the registration never ran and the program reports the country as unsupported.

decision.ruleBranch: rule 2: option A costs 9 more bytes per country than B/C and is incompatible with "sideEffects": false, so A is eliminated on bytes; rule 3: root delta 3.77% > 2% and API not fully preserved (getCountryIdFormat diverges from production) -> B
decision.rationale: rule 2: option A costs 9 more bytes per country than B/C and is incompatible with "sideEffects": false, so A is eliminated on bytes. Option C's root diverges from today's behavior (root delta 3.77% > 2%; API not fully preserved (getCountryIdFormat diverges from production)), so B is chosen and a documented breaking change is accepted for v2.
